proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our back lawn had a brown stripe every July. Marco walked each zone with us, showed us two heads spraying the fence instead of the grass, and fixed them in an afternoon. The stripe is gone.
reviews.name: Lorena P.

reviews.text: Zone 3 would not shut off and water was running down the gutter at five in the morning. They replaced the valve the next day and handed me the torn diaphragm so I could see it.
reviews.name: Gary H.

reviews.text: We swapped the sprays in the front beds for drip. The roses look better and the stucco by the garage doesn't get those white water stains anymore.
reviews.name: Anita R.

reviews.text: New system in the backyard after the pool went in. They flagged every head before trenching, so we could see the layout on the actual dirt and move two of them. Clean trench, sod laid back neatly, nothing left in the planters.
reviews.name: Doug M.

reviews.text: Water bill jumped by about half in August. They did the meter test, then found a split pipe under the side yard in under an hour. One small hole, not a torn-up lawn.
reviews.name: Pam K.

reviews.text: The old timer ran the same twenty minutes all year. Now it waters longer and earlier in summer and hardly at all in January. They also showed my husband how to read the screen.
reviews.name: Celia S.

proof.guarantee: If a head, valve or fitting we put in fails within two years, we come back and replace it.
